DIAGNOSIS READY: Coarctation of the Aorta.

The clinical picture of systemic hypertension in an otherwise healthy 5-year-old, combined with the suspicion of differential limb blood flow and potential rib notching, strongly points to a congenital narrowing of the aorta.
